principle: Organizations outfit formations with aggregate complete role-appropriate personal equipment sets. The set inherits the formation role's registered loadout, so consolidated weapon families stay mechanically meaningful without an item-by-item reserve diary. Ammunition and living mounts remain separate conserved physical stocks.

new_role_set_work.rule: A new standard set is an aggregate of the currently registered role loadout's ordinary personal arms and protection. This is procurement/manufacture work, not a monthly factory tick.

mounted_harness_work.rule: Mounted harness work covers tack and horse armor only. A horse body is never created by this set.

repair.rule: Repair restores only surviving equipment condition. Missing equipment requires a replacement role set.
